ambient_events: The open drain in the floor breathes cold air up into the room.
A paper city map on the wall is stuck with pins and threaded with string.
Somewhere far below, water moves through the dark.
description: The shop's back room, and the shop's real purpose. There is a cot, a shortwave set, a rack of clean and cared-for gear, and a paper map of Coldwater Basin marked in a private shorthand. Set into the floor is a wide drain hatch, its cover levered aside — a straight shaft down into the Under, and the Watch's way home. It goes down.
name: Fix-It Back Room
